schema.name: administrative_search
schema.description: Search administrative department documents in BigQuery. Defaults to hybrid retrieval: semantic search over documents.embedding plus keyword search over title, content, category, and headings. Images are returned only as supplementary context for matched documents.

query.description: The administrative question or exact text to search for.

search_mode.description: Retrieval mode. Use hybrid by default. Use keyword only for explicit exact-field or exact-text searches. Use semantic only when explicitly requested or for debugging.

include_images.description: Whether to fetch image metadata for matched documents. Images are supplementary and are not used as the primary search key.

filters.description: Optional exact filters applied to documents.

limit.description: Maximum number of merged document results to return.

hybrid_weights.description: Optional hybrid scoring weights. Do not set unless the user explicitly asks to tune retrieval.

schema.name: bigquery_query
schema.description: Run read-only queries against allowlisted BigQuery datasets. This tool is domain-agnostic: it does NOT know which tables hold which data. Load the relevant skill first — the skill tells you which dataset and tables to use, what the columns mean, and how to present results. Only SELECT statements are permitted; every query is dry-run first to verify its statement type, referenced tables, and scan size. Typical flow: describe_table to confirm columns, then a narrow SELECT to check what data exists, then the real query. Never guess column names — BigQuery column names in these datasets may be non-ASCII and must be wrapped in backticks in SQL.

action.description: list_datasets: show which datasets are queryable. list_tables: list tables in a dataset. describe_table: list a table's column names and types. query: run a read-only SELECT.

project.description: BigQuery project ID. Omit to use the configured default project.

dataset.description: Dataset name. Required for list_tables and describe_table. Must be within the configured allowlist.

name_prefix.description: Optional table-name prefix filter for list_tables, e.g. 'New_' to list only tables starting with New_.

sql.description: The SELECT statement to run. Required for action=query. Must be a single read-only SELECT (CTEs via WITH are fine). Fully qualify tables as `project.dataset.table`. Prefer narrow column lists and a WHERE clause over SELECT * — scan size is capped and oversized queries are rejected before they run.

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to return. Capped by server-side configuration; results beyond the cap are truncated and flagged.
